# Maintenance and servicing schedule

The workshop equipment is serviced based on the following schedule:

1. Manual devices, such as drill, Dremel: service upon failure.
2. Laser cutter: yearly check-up and maintenance based on the existing contract with the supplier.
3. SLA 3D printer (Formlabs) with washing and curing stations: filters replaced according to the manufacturer; check of the enclosure and ventilation by the GSR every six months.

The service plan for the wet lab equipment (biological safety cabinet, autoclave, centrifuge) is in [Appendix 13 of the Biological Safety concept](../_biological/13_service_plan.qmd).

# Safety check log {#safety-check-log}
